t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The blue, green, yellow and orange gnomes bring one colour basket, and other gnome brings a different colour basket. The advice was to stick with one colour basket until the mushroom count fell to zero, then switch to the other basket.

vb_textbox.text: I didn't learn anything useful or spot any patterns, sorry. The advice I received was that the orange, yellow, green and blue gnomes give the orange basket, and any other colour of gnome gives the red basket. I was advised to begin with the orange basket and stick with it until it started returning 0 mushrooms, then switch to the red basket. To be honest I didn't notice this helping. I did wonder if there was link between the score multiplier and the basket colour you should choose, but again I couldn't see any significance from my own tests. Best of luck.
